name: Summer Teens and High School Community Service at Barnes-Jewish Hospital
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in a hospital and see different health careers. Summer Teens join for at least seven weeks and 60 hours.
who_can_apply: High school students who are at least 16. Teens volunteer through their high school and get community service credit hours.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens get community service credit hours.
deadline_text: The program page says applications start in February and the Summer Teens deadline is April 1. The program page does not give a year, so check again in February.
how_to_apply: Call 314-362-5324 and ask for the student application packet. Send in all of the information at one time. If the spots are full, you can go on a waiting list.
notes: Students should not use the adult application. No more than three absences are allowed in Summer Teens. School-year community service hours are possible when there is room. Call the Volunteer Office to ask.
